seasons.title: Delivery Boys & Detectives
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms, takes courier jobs, and investigates the Oogathal/Pyrelight conspiracy — uncovering Grayson's necromantic manor and the Roundhat Gang's were-creature threat. The arc ends in catastrophe: a botched ambush at the Crowded Flea leaves Argyle, Benny, and Johnny dead in a total party kill.

seasons.title: Back from the Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: Johnny and Benny's souls are resurrected through Aut in the Black and White, and the reformed party — joined by Sir Arctos — hunts down Hlarf, then assaults Tywelwyn Leatherhide in his fiery Fane. They discover the sentient heart, learn of six Thessian gods attempting to crack the Firmament via radar dishes, and report the conspiracy to both the Convox and the Inquisition — only for Detective Brooks to be abducted.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage Hunt
seasons.arc_summary: Anaïs's rescue unveils the cosmic Narrative — five sibling entities including the party's patron Aut — and the party learns of a pilgrimage offering passage aboard a colossal Strider. They compete in a keystone scavenger hunt, assassinate the demon Sbrtlby Jones, trade a stolen painting for Keystone 14, and learn Argyle has returned from death — but only half of him.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: After securing their keystone, the party enters extended downtime while investigating Argyle's suspicious resurrection, then descends into the royal waterways where they discover a hairline fracture in reality — a parallel world imprisoning the god Giant behind the Firmament. They uncover a vast conspiracy funded by Grayson and the Prime Minister, bomb the research facility, and collapse Teller's Run underground before embarking on the pilgrimage.

seasons.title: Aboard the Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party embarks on the pilgrimage road trip, arrives at the colossal arachnid Strider, and births their own heart 'Eerie' to build a Fane. They spend a week networking among the nineteen factions aboard, discover the Harlequin Master of Ceremonies is a devil who expects deadly conflict, and survive the first horrific tithe — where Garrick Textiles is wrung dry and void monsters erupt onto the dance floor.

seasons.title: The Undercroft Wars
seasons.arc_summary: The party builds a coalition of factions, harvests weaker hearts for energy, and descends into the Strider's Undercroft to forge an alliance with the ancient Machine God. They assault the sleeping clan's hospital, poison the corrupted heart Lifeline, and Anzu makes a breakthrough on countering the Herald's Song — just as Verdant Holdings is sabotaged and cosmic siblings of the Narrative begin watching the Strider.

seasons.title: Stranded Beyond the Map
seasons.arc_summary: The party accidentally destroys the Menhir — a member of the cosmic Narrative — using a god-killing revolver, catapulting the Strider to a dead, scoured world far off the atlas. Stranded with angry cosmic siblings watching, they broker a fragile ceasefire with Grayson, rescue the mind-controlled gunslinger Egan from the Herald's song, and assault the Strider's corrupted spire to get the massive machine moving again.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: The Terror of Cagley
seasons.arc_summary: Four 8th-grade heroes descend into Mt. Cagley and slay the shadow demon Terror through a prolonged battle where stacked fear defenses neutralize its signature mechanics. The session also opens a new chapter as Scale operatives arrive on a shattered Joker World and clash with demonic swarms.

seasons.title: The Quorum's Heart
seasons.arc_summary: Scale operatives investigate a mysterious slip-shielded structure called the Quorum, battling through fiendish forces and solving its puzzles before descending through a bloodfall portal to free Voice of Many — a trapped divine heart — in a desperate ten-round defense and escape.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: Three convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders tied to a mysterious visitor, journey deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse following a Feyrock necklace, and confront a court of fey creatures connected to the curse before continuing their hunt into Hallia's underworld.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: Following fey stone leads, the Convox tracks a black-raimented ritual killer through a jeweler's conference to the Gullet, discovers the Gloaming Codex, and is pulled into its pages to battle carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Sedecium agents Scrazzy, Foral, and Ozzie investigate an unpowered orbital station half-sunk in the slip, where they free a tortured ship AI, rotate the station back into real space, and uncover that the Thessian Esoterica accessed ancient observatory logs pointing to a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement for a single daring raid, the fire team descends through the Slip to the surface of the freshly-killed Thessian god Tithe, solving a time-acceleration puzzle and fighting through a spider temple to plant a beacon — becoming the first and only team to successfully steal divine essence before the God Eater Harrow can consume it.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
